name: @pletivo/runtime
description: Pletivo render-time runtime: JSX SSR runtime, Astro shim, islands and hydration. Ships TypeScript source.
//: No build step, by design. `exports` points at source. A dist/ build would give modules that hold process-global state (base, the island registry, the render-tracking store) two module records when one importer resolves through exports and another through a relative path.

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo 'publish the staged tarball from scripts/package-pletivo.ts, not this directory' >&2 && exit 1
